subject.title: Steer mode does not inject messages mid-turn for main sessions

question: Should PR 89238, or a refreshed successor, be the canonical path for ordinary same-session visible messages to bypass busy admission and reach active-run queue policy?
rationale: The remaining behavior crosses message-delivery ordering, session-state ownership, and no-visible fallback semantics, and the existing candidate is both conflicting and reviewed as semantically incomplete.

options.title: Refresh the admission-layer PR
options.body: Treat PR 89238 as the canonical path, rebase or replace it on current main, and fix the fallback/session-state semantics before merge.

options.title: Limit steering to explicit controls for now
options.body: Keep ordinary messages queued while documenting that only explicit controls like /steer have the current active-run bypass until maintainers redesign ordinary ingress.

options.title: Split channel-specific follow-ups
options.body: Keep this issue canonical for the broad bug and open narrower channel issues only if Telegram, Discord, or WebChat require different ownership.

recommendation.title: Refresh the admission-layer PR
recommendation.body: Treat PR 89238 as the canonical path, rebase or replace it on current main, and fix the fallback/session-state semantics before merge.
